layout_select_when: One subject family must read as a collection, sequence, repeated signal, inventory, or packaging rhythm.
layout_dominant_mass: title plus one repeated family; one instance owns the focal scale
layout_title_zone: one protected band, gap, or corner left open by the repetition
layout_object_slot: 2–5 instances from one subject family with varied scale, crop, or angle
layout_collision_rule: title touches at most one contour; repeated instances establish rhythm rather than surrounding every line
layout_crop_rule: at least one instance may crop at an edge; one largest instance remains the visual anchor
layout_required_structure: one coherent path or grid rhythm
layout_thumbnail_test: the field reads as one family with one dominant instance, not decorative wallpaper
subject_assembly_count: two to five instances from one subject family
subject_mass_rule: Repeat one family only; vary scale, crop, angle, or spacing while one instance owns the focal scale and the group follows one coherent path.

composition_operators.definition: Arrange one repeated family along one readable path or controlled grid rhythm.
Protect one open band or corner from subjects so title and facts remain readable.
Attach at least three major or support elements to one shared edge, axis, baseline, or curvature.
Create one memorable scale, crop, angle, or spacing variation inside an otherwise coherent repeated path.

composition_sentence: TITLE_MASS + REPEATED_FAMILY + REPEAT_ON_PATH + RHYTHM_VARIATION + RELEASE_ZONE + OPEN_TITLE_BAND
subject_origin_definition: An invented, apparently functional object imagined through optimistic streamline-era futurism: a rounded, exaggerated volume with coherent construction logic and a small set of purpose-bearing parts.
subject_identity_contract: name one hypothetical function before defining the form
resolve one SPECULATIVE_MORPHOLOGY before detailing: BUBBLE_CAPSULE, STREAMLINE_POD, BIOMORPHIC_APPARATUS, or SOFT_VERTICAL_INFRASTRUCTURE
build from one dominant sphere, ovoid, teardrop, inflated spindle, or soft monolith; exaggerate one proportion before adding details
lock 2–4 purpose-bearing parts such as bubble canopy, rounded aperture, docking seam, integrated support, shrouded wheel, keel, grip, mount, sensor, or status window
make every secondary part follow the dominant curvature; use no scattered controls or decorative technology noise
prefer colored enamel, molded fiberglass, creamy lacquer, translucent resin, bubble glass, warm metal trim, and optional upholstery over cold gray-white minimalism
do not use fake brands, invented readable labels, present-day product baselines, faceted EV styling, black glass bands, full-width LED strips, or generic AI product-render details
render_treatment_definition: Build the form or invented device from the active palette so its body, light, shadow, haze, and gradient read as one continuous color system.
render_color_rule: Object color derives from ACTIVE_HUES and their tints; no unrelated local product color is introduced.
scale_role_scale: 2–5 instances with one focal scale and at least two subordinate scales or crops
scale_role_behavior: Repeat one family only; preserve one dominant rhythm and one quiet release zone.
speculative_morphology_definition: An inhabited or instrumented sphere/ovoid whose transparent dome is a major part of the silhouette.
speculative_morphology_silhouette: one near-spherical or egg-shaped body with a large convex glass canopy or rounded portal occupying roughly one-third to two-thirds of the visible front or upper volume
speculative_morphology_exaggeration: make the canopy unusually generous and the lower shell compact, swollen, or suspended
speculative_morphology_aperture_rule: use one continuous bubble canopy or deep rounded portal with a warm trim ring; no flat windshield or black glass band
speculative_morphology_construction_cues: one opening or docking seam following the sphere
one integrated cradle, keel, or suspension point
optional upholstered inner shell visible through the canopy
speculative_morphology_material_directio: colored fiberglass or creamy lacquer body, clear or softly tinted bubble glass, restrained warm chrome or brushed metal ring, tactile upholstered interior when inhabited
speculative_global_form_ancestry: Streamline Moderne, postwar coachbuilding, mid-century space-age illustration, bubble canopies, molded fiberglass, and optimistic world-fair futurism—not contemporary EV, smartphone, appliance, or cold minimal-product language.
speculative_global_construction_order: choose one dominant geometric body: sphere, ovoid, teardrop, inflated spindle, or softly rising monolith
exaggerate one proportion so the silhouette is memorable before small details appear
integrate one transparent canopy, aperture, or observation opening into the dominant volume
add only 1–3 function-bearing seams, supports, fins, docking bands, wheel shrouds, or sensor openings that follow the same curvature
speculative_global_required_character: continuous convex curves and generous radii dominate the outer silhouette
the object feels rounded, buoyant, aerodynamic, and slightly theatrical rather than optimized by current industrial-design convention
glazing is volumetric bubble glass or a rounded portal, never a flat black screen slab
materials feel warm and tactile: colored enamel, molded fiberglass, creamy lacquer, translucent resin, warm chrome trim, amber or smoke-tinted glass, and optional upholstered interior
rendering may be sculptural, illustrated, model-like, or softly surreal; realism is subordinate to silhouette clarity, warmth, and imaginative exaggeration
one or two seams may explain opening, docking, suspension, or maintenance; decorative control noise is absent
speculative_global_hard_failures: a current car, appliance, laptop, speaker, robot, or phone with rounded corners
faceted stealth surfaces, razor edges, angular cybertruck geometry, or aggressive contemporary supercar stance
black panoramic glass bands, full-width LED strips, touchscreen-first dashboards, RGB light, holographic UI, or cold gray-white minimalism
generic matte ceramic blob with no silhouette exaggeration, canopy, aperture, or functional construction logic
photoreal automotive advertising, cinematic road scenes, chrome covering the whole object, or hard neon rim light
screen_state_definition: The selected subject has no generated screen behavior.
screen_rendering_rule: Do not add a display, interface, glow, or control surface merely to make the subject look technological.
focal_event: One object family repeats at varied scale, crop, or angle while one instance owns the focal scale.
release_zone: a visibly quieter band with no extra copies or pseudo-data
focal_event_thumbnail_test: the image reads as one family, not a decorative pattern
derived_tints: derive pale, mid, and soft-deep tones only from the active hues
saturation_rule: allow only one saturation focus; render all other hues as softened fields, haze, or translucent layers
gradient_direction: diffuse light spreads along an asymmetric soft horizon

spatial_assignment: obey the layout collision rule: title touches at most one contour; repeated instances establish rhythm rather than surrounding every line Distribute visual weight before establishing alignment; do not concentrate the title, hero, and decorative axis on one side unless the opposite region has a clear compositional role
title_clear_zone: the union of visible title glyph silhouettes plus a calm buffer of about 4% of canvas width; the primary form's solid silhouette, luminous core, and highest-contrast edge must stay outside it; soft low-contrast atmosphere may pass behind only when glyph edges and thumbnail readability remain crisp
primary_form_clearance: CATEGORY_LABEL outlines, ANCHOR, ECHO, and decorative lines must not cross the primary form's core contour, highest-contrast region, or visual center; place them along an outer edge, tangent, or extended axis instead
collision_resolution: preserve approved wording and readable title scale; use balanced reflow when suitable, otherwise translate or modestly scale the primary form; never preserve centered placement at the cost of glyph clearance
detail_limits: one accent language plus at most one hairline bridge; accents under 2% combined canvas area
detail_grammar: one ANCHOR, zero or one BRIDGE, and one or two ECHO instances using one returned accent language
alignment_system: first distribute visual weight across complementary regions, then align at least three of title, hero or atmospheric form, panel, label, bridge, and accents through a shared edge, axis, tangent, baseline, or curvature; the relationship may span the canvas and must not stack all high-information elements in one region
